npcs.name: Kasumi Nakren
npcs.description: Kasumi Nakren is a Kender runaway tinkerer whose curiosity is tangled with fear that her memories, body, or family story may not be entirely her own. She fled to Lunethryl chasing answers about identity, constructed life, and hidden communities, but her bravery is still the bravery of someone young enough to mistake danger for proof. The Choral Synod sees her as a vulnerable witness and a brilliant little engineer; she sees herself as a question no adult has answered honestly.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Lunethryl is a City in Vaelmyrith, under Council Republic, with severe danger, Beach and reefs with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Kender reads through the Kender entry of the race compendium, within Halfling and Smallfolk, marked by Ishtanora. Kender are endlessly curious wanderers with a fearless approach to danger and novelty. They often collect objects impulsively, driven by an almost compulsive sense of exploration. Table cues: Fearless, Kender Aptitude, Taunt; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Pragmatic.
rumors: Kasumi Nakren knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Enkirday.
Kasumi Nakren has a contact in Zarveng who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Kasumi Nakren asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Kasumi Nakren's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Stockton Oldroad
npcs.description: Stockton Oldroad is a kindly but stubborn Jaspey caravan patron who hides dangerous compassion behind slow speech, old blankets, and boring invoices. He uses The Brass Concordat routes to move food, medicine, and people with changed names, especially those fleeing the Glasswell Institute or ichor-debt bondage. Stockton looks harmless until someone threatens a traveler under his protection; then every wagon, innkeeper, and toll clerk he has ever helped becomes part of the escape plan.

rumors: Stockton's wagons carry more false-bottom compartments than trade goods on some nights.

plotHooks: Stockton asks the party to escort a silent passenger whose pursuers insist they are stolen property.
